timing.title: Stage timing
timing.hint: Start manually. Finish the current stage before starting another. Timing appears on the confidence monitor.
timing.duration_hint: Optional. Use 0 to show elapsed time only.
timing.invalid_duration: Enter a value between 0 and 1440 minutes.
timing.end_time_hint: Local time on the day the stage starts. Pausing does not postpone this time. Past times are already overdue.
